decisions.reason: “Who had opened the window, then?” naturalizes 그럼 (‘then’) without BASE’s fronted “So who,” reading smoother.
“small whine” and “soft whine” both render 작게 칭얼거렸다 equally well; no real gain.
Korean 여자 누구? asks “which woman”; “What woman?” shifts the question form.
“like a private hearing reveille” tracks 기상나팔 소리를 들은 이등병; BASE adds “startled awake,” not in source.
“stunned twice over” reads more naturally than “startled twice” while keeping 두 번 놀랐다.
SOL’s “heart pounding” collides with the later 쿵쾅거린다 rendering; BASE’s “heart skip” keeps 떨리다 distinct.
Korean 벗은 몸 (naked body) is explicit; BASE censors it to “herself.” SOL also “provocative” for 자극적인.
“heard plenty about” is more concise and idiomatic than “heard about plenty of times,” same meaning.
“situation was becoming more and more baffling” captures 점점 미궁으로 빠지는; “After staring… I grabbed” flows better.
“shimmered dark blue” is cleaner than “shimmered a dark blue”; “peered” fits bleary 게슴츠레한 eyes.
“released spring” better describes the upward pop of 용수철처럼 튀어 올랐다 than the static “compressed spring.”
“prickled across my skin” renders the spread of 소름이 쫙 끼쳤다 more vividly than “broke out in goose bumps.”
“will be granted” matches ~됩니다 phrasing used elsewhere; “The player’s current language can be changed” is less clunky than BASE.
“marveled at her all over again” is more natural than “admired her once again” for 다시 한번 감탄했다.
“By then” supplies the temporal connective of 끝난 후였다 and reads more smoothly.
“issue commands aloud or in my head” fixes BASE’s awkward “think my commands,” matching 속으로 생각해도 된다.
게임을 하고 있다 means “playing a game”; BASE’s “inside a game” alters the phrasing.
떠올리려는 찰나 is progressive “was trying to recall”; SOL’s simple “tried” loses that nuance.
힐끔거리면서 is repeated furtive glancing; “stole glances” preserves the iteration BASE’s “glanced” drops.
“cooling me all the way to my stomach” tracks 식도를 타고 배 속까지 시원해지는; BASE adds “wave of coolness.”
“never imagined” vs “I’d never imagined” are equally natural; no meaningful gain.
“everyone goes on about virtual reality” captures the reduplication 가상현실, 가상현실 하는구나; BASE flattens it.
어느새 곰방대를 문 attaches “already” to the pipe (as SOL does); BASE misattaches it to “watching.”
보고 싶어서? is “wanted to see you?”; “look at you” drifts from the standard rendering.
Present 알아요 is “do you know”; BASE’s “did you know” shifts tense.
Both render 게임 진행 방식이 참신하다 equivalently; “game’s progression” is no worse for concision.
Title-casing quest objective and reward labels (“Gather Information,” “Sturdy Martial Uniform Set”) matches game-UI field style consistently.
단도직입적 already conveys directness; “tobacco smoke” is more concise than “smoke from her pipe.”
“choked in the middle of exhaling smoke” captures 연기를 내뱉다 말고 사레가 들렸다; BASE’s “choked on the smoke” misframes it.
관아 is the magistrate’s office, fitting the murim setting better than generic “local government”; “distribute” fine for 풀다.
Preserves the 거목 tree metaphor of 뿌리 깊은 거목이랄까; BASE replaces it with generic “powers.”
맹주 is alliance overlord; “hegemon” conveys the political rank better than generic “leader.”
Source says 이상한 (strange); SOL narrows it to “uneasy” without support.
장난삼아 묻는 건데 is “asking in jest”; “I’m only asking as a joke” is more accurate than BASE’s “This is just a joke.”
“I couldn’t decide whether to laugh or cry” reads more naturally than “Whether I should laugh or cry, I had no idea.”
상당히 높은 직급 = “fairly/considerably high-ranking”; BASE drops the modifier entirely.
별의별 이야기가 다 나왔음에도 = “all the various things”; SOL drops the 별의별 emphasis.
“I’m sorry to say this” is the standard idiom for 이런 말 해서 미안한데; “put it this way” is looser.
“Yeah.” matches 그러게 (‘right/yeah’); BASE’s “Well” changes the agreement tone.
“being stuck at” and “getting stuck on” the tutorial are equivalent; no meaningful improvement.
“hadn’t been bad for the little while I’d played it” tracks 잠깐 플레이한 것치곤 나쁘지 않았다; BASE’s “had been fun” overstates.
눈인사 is an eye-greeting/farewell nod; BASE’s “nod” keeps the greeting sense that “glance” loses.
Removing the comma after “at least” corrects punctuation; no meaning change.
These lines are the manual’s 주의 사항 (read precautions), not System messages, so labeling them System violates the manual/warning rule; SOL’s “Warning” heading is correct.
